tasks.spec:
You are a code-feature worker implementing Phase 10b (the dashboard) of MonetaFox Reborn, a Microsoft Money replacement PWA at /home/user/Source/MonetaFoxReborn (the REPO). Read plan-reborn.md (Phase 10) and spec.md (Reports & Dashboard: 'Dashboard includes: recent transactions, upcoming bills, account balances') first. Phase 10a already built the reports analytics + Reports page; THIS task builds the DASHBOARD (the index route '/'). Reuse (do NOT reimplement): src/lib/reports/ (netWorth, netWorthOverTime), src/lib/accounts/ (accountBalance), src/lib/currency/ (formatCurrency), src/lib/scheduling/ (for due/next dates), the stores (useAccountStore, useTransactionStore, useScheduledStore, useInvestmentStore, useSettingsStore for baseCurrency + rates), and Recharts. src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx currently renders a stub — replace it.

CONVENTIONS (pinned by a hidden contract test): recentTransactions returns the most recent N transactions sorted NEWEST FIRST by date. upcomingScheduled returns schedules whose nextDate falls in the inclusive window [asOf, asOf+withinDays], sorted soonest-first; items already past (nextDate < asOf) or beyond the window are excluded. ('Upcoming bills' = upcoming scheduled transactions from Phase 8.)

BOUNDARY / OWNERSHIP: Edit directly in the REPO working tree. You OWN only: src/lib/dashboard/** (create), src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx (build the real page), and new src/components/dashboard/** files. Do NOT modify src/lib/db/**, crypto/auth, the stores, other pages, routes.tsx, Layout.tsx, App.tsx, the .md files, or .ringer/. Do NOT add dependencies. Do NOT git commit or push. (Read the stores; do not edit them.)

DELIVERABLE — implement with this EXACT public API (a hidden contract test pins it):
1. src/lib/dashboard/index.ts (pure, well-tested):
   - export function recentTransactions(transactions: Transaction[], limit: number): Transaction[] — sorted by date descending, first `limit`.
   - export function upcomingScheduled(schedules: ScheduledTransaction[], asOf: string, withinDays: number): ScheduledTransaction[] — nextDate in [asOf, asOf+withinDays] inclusive, sorted ascending by nextDate.
2. src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx — a real dashboard reading the stores + base currency/rates from settings, with cards/sections for: (a) NET WORTH and per-ACCOUNT BALANCES (use reports.netWorth + accounts.accountBalance, formatted via formatCurrency; optionally a small net-worth-over-time sparkline via Recharts), (b) RECENT TRANSACTIONS (recentTransactions, e.g. last 5-10, with links into Transactions), and (c) UPCOMING BILLS (upcomingScheduled over e.g. the next 30 days, with the payee/amount/due date). Handle empty state gracefully.

HOW TO VERIFY before finishing (from REPO root), running each ONCE: `corepack pnpm run typecheck`, `corepack pnpm run test`, `corepack pnpm run lint`, `corepack pnpm run build` — all exit 0. (Suite is deterministic; one run — do NOT loop it.) Write real Vitest tests for the two selectors.

OUTPUT CONTRACT: make the changes in owned paths, then write ./notes.md in your task dir: what you read, files created/changed, commands run with results, the selector semantics, the dashboard layout, and any follow-up.

HARD RULES: match the API signatures + conventions exactly (recent newest-first; upcoming within an inclusive window, soonest-first); reuse existing layers (reports/accounts/currency/scheduling); do NOT edit db/stores; keep it typed and boring; keep the suite deterministic; do not touch files outside ownership; do not commit.
tasks.verified: A hidden contract test passes (recentTransactions newest-first + limit; upcomingScheduled within an inclusive [asOf, asOf+withinDays] window, soonest-first, excluding past/too-far items). The dashboard module exists with the exact API; DashboardPage reads the stores and surfaces recent transactions, upcoming bills, and net worth / account balances. The Phase 10a/3a/1 contract tests still pass; typecheck + suite + lint + build exit 0. Only owned paths changed; nothing committed.
